method derivative(xs: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |xs| > 0 // The input list must have at least one coefficient
    ensures |result| == |xs| - 1 // The output list will have one less coefficient than the input
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == (i + 1) * xs[i + 1] // Each coefficient in the result is the derivative of the corresponding term
{
    var n := |xs|; // Get the length of the input sequence
    var temp := new int[n - 1]; // Create a new sequence for the result
    var i := 0;

    while i < n - 1
        invariant 0 <= i <= n - 1 // i is within bounds
        invariant temp[..] == [j * xs[j + 1] | j <- 0..i - 1] // temp contains the correctly computed values up to i
    {
        temp[i] := (i + 1) * xs[i + 1]; // Compute the derivative term
        i := i + 1; // Move to the next coefficient
    }

    result := temp; // Set the result to the computed derivative sequence
}
```
